verdict.rationale: Veriff publishes endpoint-level API reference pages (e.g. v1sessions) and an official Veriff Public API Postman collection, which gives users runnable requests. The interactivity depends on Postman, an external tool, and there is no evidence of an in-page try-it console. The OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any standard path. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive console in the API reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent hands-on corroboration that the runnable examples work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
